LanguageData.LP_Offer_Silver.label: offer silver
LanguageData.LP_Offer_Silver.description: Offer 100 silver at the altar: patron deity divine favor +1 (by silver market value, +1 per 100).
LanguageData.LP_Offer_Silver.jobString: Making an offering to the patron deity.
LanguageData.LP_Offer_Shard.label: offer a miracle fragment
LanguageData.LP_Offer_Shard.description: Return a fragment of a miracle to the god: patron deity divine favor +10.
LanguageData.LP_Offer_Shard.jobString: Making an offering to the patron deity.
LanguageData.LP_Offer_Liked.label: offer a favored sacrifice to the patron deity
LanguageData.LP_Offer_Liked.description: Offer one portion (market value 60) of something the patron deity loves; divine favor = market value × 3 (about +1.8 per portion). Each god likes different things; see the divine favor overview on the altar. After changing patron deity, the recipe switches automatically to what the new god likes.
LanguageData.LP_Offer_Liked.jobString: Making an offering to the patron deity.
